title: ArrangementBroken.v1
description: Payload of the ArrangementBroken event (A§23). Emitted by arrangement-service — the single producer (A§7.2) — when an ACTIVE plan is broken (A§10.3 ACTIVE -> BROKEN): an instalment stays unpaid past its grace period, detected by `tick breach-check --as-of=<date>` (SVC-5), or the plan is broken explicitly via `POST /v1/arrangements/{id}/break`. Published on `collections.arrangement` keyed by `arrangementId` (A§23), so it is ordered behind the ArrangementCreated it terminates. case-service appends a case activity and sets `next_action_at` to now on it (EXE-1), and payment-service drops the plan from its active-arrangement read model so later money goes to DEBT instead of instalments (SVC-6). Rides the A§24 envelope; a breaking change ships as ArrangementBroken.v2 (D§29).

arrangementId.description: Platform identifier of the broken arrangement. Equal to the envelope `aggregateId` and the Kafka partition key (A§23).

accountId.description: Platform identifier of the account whose plan was broken — the key payment-service maintains its `active_arrangements` read model on, so it can invalidate the entry without holding the creation event.

reason.description: Why the arrangement was broken. Open SCREAMING_SNAKE vocabulary rather than a closed enum: breach detection rules are configurable per product and grow over time, and a new reason must not force a v2. INSTALLMENT_MISSED is the value the automated breach tick emits.
